title.zh: 【OnePay 支持 USDC 直接转入支票账户余额】
title.en: 【OnePay 支持 USDC 直接转入支票账户余额】

current_state.zh: Walmart-backed fintech app OnePay now lets users send USDC directly into their existing OnePay checking-account balance for bill payments and transfers, bypassing exchange conversion.
